name: Provo Network+
description: Provo by MyComputerCareer: exam readiness for CompTIA Network+ (N10-009). Acronyms, OSI model, ports, subnetting, media and wireless, security, troubleshooting, tools and commands, question qualifiers, performance-based questions, mini-exams, and a one-page cram sheet. To add it to a note, open Tools > Provo Network+ > How to use and click Copy command, then paste into a note. Or type ```net+ on one line and ``` on the next.
